title: Completion of the Assembly Rewind
statement: Let $S,V$ be finite deterministic machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $S$ on $x$, and let $y$ be a Boolean word. If $j$ is a natural number with $j\le |y|$ and $w$ is a Boolean choice word of length $j+1$, then running the host built from $S,V$ under $w$ from the assembly-rewind configuration with assembly head at cell $j-1$ yields the verifier-phase configuration for the initial configuration of $V$ on $y$, with boundary tag true, input head at the position of $c$, and the scheduler tapes and heads inherited from $c$.
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines, $d$ a scheduler configuration, $y$ an assembled word, $j \le |y|$, and $w$ any choice word with $|w| = j + 1$. Running the host under $w$ from the assembly-rewind configuration with head at cell $j - 1$ reaches the verifier-phase configuration for the initial configuration of $V$ on $y$.
